notes: Clicked for credits 20 times on turns 5-9 while sitting on 20-38 credits with nothing to spend them on, and never ran the naked Server 2 holding Longevity Serum on turn 4 (scored turn 5). On turns 10-14 it kept running Server 3 into the known Anemone, taking net damage and jacking out after passing it, while Fujii Asset Retrieval was advanced in Server 5 over turns 12-15 and scored for the win.

Solid scoring behind Hagen in Server 3 with Seamless Launch fast-advances (Architect Deployment Test turn 11, Project Ingatan turn 13, Méliès turn 16). Minor issues: R&D was guarded only by non-ETR Drafter for turns 1-3 (Project Ingatan stolen turn 3), and it clicked for credits while holding 12-15 credits on turns 5 and 14.

After two Strike Funds on turn 1 it installed nothing all game and clicked for credits nearly every click up to 68 credits, holding the same 5 cards. Its only runs were single facechecks into remotes with no breakers (Descent turns 7/12/15, Afshar turn 11), and it never ran HQ or R&D while the Corp scored five agendas from remotes.

Used Ansel 1.0 and Vertigo on R&D well to lock the Runner out, and scored Méliès behind Hagen (turn 7) and then Megaprix/Superconducting Hub/Megaprix from Server 3. Economy got thin (0 credits after turn 7, clicking for credits on turns 3 and 8), but no agenda was exposed.

Efficient aggressive game: Jailbreak on HQ turn 3 stole two agendas, Carpe Diem on Archives turn 4 took a discarded Hybrid Release, and Docklands Pass on HQ turn 5 won the game. Only small oddities, such as two credit clicks on turn 5 and running the Mavirus remote turn 2.

It built three ice on Server 1 (turns 1, 3, 4, 6) but never installed an agenda there, then clicked for credits on turns 10-15 up to 21 credits with a full hand, discarding each turn. Méliès and Project Ingatan sat in HQ behind only Hagen and were stolen on turns 12 and 15 after Méliès had already been seen on turn 11.

It kept bouncing off Descent with no answer to it (Server 1 turns 10/12/14, Server 2 turn 16), and on turns 16-20 it paid 3-5 a run to break Ballista on HQ for low-value accesses, letting Ballista trash Banner on turn 20. On turn 21 it clicked for credits while a 2-advanced agenda sat in Server 1 and was scored next turn for the loss, though the turn-15 double Above the Law steal was good.

It never installed a single card and clicked for credits almost every turn up to 59 credits. Its only remote runs were breakerless facechecks into Descent (turns 12/13/14) and Tree Line (turns 13/16) while the Corp scored Above the Law twice, Transport Monopoly and Divested Trust; the turn-11 Archives steal of two discarded Transport Monopolies was luck.

Economy collapsed after the turn-4 Grubber rez, leaving it at 0-4 credits from turn 6 onward and discarding to hand size every turn. It reinstalled Tomorrow's Headline on turn 9 in the same Grubber remote the Runner had already paid through for Embedded Reporting on turn 5, and on turns 9-12 it spent 2 credits and a click each turn trashing Daily Casts while HQ (with agendas in it) and R&D stayed thin.

Sensible game against a passive Runner: Post-Truth Dividend was installed and scored in one turn (turns 5 and 10), and Embedded Reporting and Next Big Thing were scored behind iced Server 3. The turn-2 Public Trail tag went unused, and it clicked for credits on turns 6-8 while holding cards.

Scored 5 points by turn 12 behind remote ice, then took 10 more turns to win. It clicked for credits repeatedly on turns 7, 9, 10, 13 and 20 at 9-13 credits, and played Oppo Research for 4 tags twice (turns 15 and 19, 7 credits each) with nothing to punish the tags.

Good pressure: Boi-tatá on Ballista took Transport Monopoly from HQ (turn 3) and Divested Trust from Server 1 (turn 4), and Buzzsaw plus Boi-tatá took SDS (turn 9) and the winning Above the Law (turn 12). A minor issue is four credit clicks at 10-14 credits on turn 5 instead of pressuring.

It opened with three ice and no economy, then rezzed Grubber (taking bad publicity) and dropped to 0 credits. On turn 2 it installed Embedded Reporting behind a lone Ping, which was stolen, and it played Oppo Research on turns 3 and 5 with no way to use the tags while Tomorrow's Headline sat in a weak HQ (stolen turn 4).

It ran unchanged R&D four times a turn on turns 2-5, seeing the same top card each time, while ignoring the naked advanced Hybrid Release in Server 2 (scored turn 4) and Longevity Serum in Server 1 (scored turn 3). Later it clicked for credits on turns 8-12 with 11-30 credits, letting Regenesis (turn 11) and the winning Project Yagi-Uda (installed turn 13, scored turn 15) go uncontested.

It ran into the known Saisentan on R&D without breaking it on turns 6 and 9, taking 3 net damage each time and losing Red Team, Tremolo and then Revolver, which left it no way into Server 2. It got stuck on 6 points, spending turns 10-13 on low-value HQ runs (Vampyronassa three times on turn 10) while Longevity Serum and Project Yagi-Uda were scored from Server 2.

HQ had only the non-ETR Wave all game while the Runner hit it every turn with Docklands Pass, and Megaprix (turn 4), Project Ingatan (turn 6) and Méliès (turn 12) were all stolen from HQ. Instead it put three or four ice on Server 1 and three on Server 2, clicked for credits on turns 9-10, and never moved Méliès from HQ into its well-iced remote.

It won with Banner to beat Akhet in Server 1 (Transport Monopoly turn 10, SDS turn 13), but sat on 15 credits on turn 3 drawing instead of contesting the advanced Transport Monopoly the Corp scored on turn 4. It also spent a click and 2 credits most turns clearing Trickster Taka tags, and drew and clicked for credits on turn 12 while an agenda was being advanced in Server 1.

It hoarded up to 47 credits with a full hand, clicking for credits and discarding on turns 7-18, and never installed an agenda into the four-ice Server 3 it built on turns 5-11. Ansel put Architect Deployment Test in a naked Server 2 on turn 4 and it was advanced but stolen on turn 5, Project Ingatan was taken from HQ on turn 14, and Méliès was taken from R&D on turn 18 for the loss.

It won on turn 7 by scoring Méliès twice (turns 4 and 6) and Megaprix from Server 1 behind Ablative Barrier, using the Méliès extra click to re-install immediately and Ansel to add remote ice. The only risk was trusting a single ice on the scoring remote early.

It never installed a card. After open-HQ runs on turns 1-3 and breakerless facechecks into Tree Line (turn 2), Afshar (turn 5) and Descent (turn 9), it clicked for credits on turns 6-12 up to 36 credits. Meanwhile the Corp advanced and scored Transport Monopoly (turn 8), Divested Trust (turn 10) and the winning Transport Monopoly that had sat in Server 2 since turn 2.
